overview: The Medford City Council addressed hazardous conditions at an abandoned property on Boynton Road and requested mitigation for persistent noise issues from Lawrence Memorial Hospital. The meeting also included significant debate regarding the city's new parking kiosk program, infrastructure delays at Craddock Bridge, and the status of public access television.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Noise Petition
items.summary: Council requested that Hallmark Health pay $400 for an independent acoustical study at a resident's home to address persistent noise from the hospital's power plant.

items.title: Hazardous Condition at 56 Boynton Road
items.summary: Directed the building, health, and fire departments to take immediate action to secure or remediate an abandoned property, and requested a legal opinion from the city solicitor regarding the council's authority to demolish the structure.

items.title: Sportsmanship Award Recognition
items.summary: Approved a resolution recognizing student-athletes Andrew Cronin and Adrienne Perrazzo for receiving the Boston Bruins Sportsmanship Award.

items.title: Riverside Avenue Business Licenses
items.summary: Approved Common Victualler licenses for Panera Bread and Noodles and Company, with recommendations that both establishments implement charcoal filtration systems to mitigate odors.

items.title: Colonial VW Class I License
items.summary: Approved a Class I auto dealer license for Colonial VW of Medford at its new facility on Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Unity Cab Medallion Upgrade
items.summary: Approved a request to upgrade a vehicle under an existing taxi medallion.

items.title: Public Park Street Hockey
items.summary: Referred a request to the Park Board and Traffic Commission to lift prohibitions on street hockey in public parks after reports of restrictive signage at Playstead Park.

items.title: Craddock Bridge Rehabilitation Review
items.summary: Requested that MassDOT officials appear before the council to address the project's timeline, lack of communication, and mitigation plans for local businesses during construction.

items.title: Resolution Response Tracking
items.summary: Voted to add a 10-day deadline column to the city clerk’s resolution tracking report following complaints about the mayor's failure to provide timely responses to council requests.

items.title: Medford Square Lighting and Kiosk Issues
items.summary: Approved a request for National Grid and the mayor's office to address chronic power outages and technical errors in the parking kiosk program, including the collection of fees during non-enforcement hours.

items.title: Condolences to the family of Sam Roslando
items.summary: Adopted a resolution offering condolences to the family of Sam Roslando and held a moment of silence in his honor.

items.title: Community Media Platform Bid Status
items.summary: Requested updates from the purchasing agent and city solicitor regarding a single bid received for a new public access station and the status of PEG funds under the Comcast contract.
